notes: Experimental is now the normal game (same as the main version) plus a disconnect fix: when a player's connection stalls, the game now waits up to 30 seconds instead of dropping them after 5 (also in online lobbies). Everyone in a match needs this version for it to work. Chaos Theory beta is off experimental for now. If you were on the previous experimental: after the update press Settings > Restore stock, then PLAY. If you still get dropped, send the log bundle from the launcher.
